dedupe_keys.name: national land numerical information ksj road data n01 japan

description: The road data (N01) of Japan's National Land Numerical Information (KSJ) hold the road network defined under the Road Act, including national expressways, national roads, prefectural and municipal roads, as lines with road type code, route name, line name and common name. They were digitised by MLIT from 1:25,000 (partly 1:50,000) topographic maps, road management maps and expressway route charts with 1:200,000 maps used to select other roads, for the base year 1995, and converted from the old format to GML in fiscal 2010, when surplus geometry and domain errors were removed. Coverage is national (Japan), by prefecture and as one national file. The data are free to download as JPGIS GML and shapefiles (national file about 24 MB, in world and Tokyo datums); no use licence is stated on the page. Caveats: the page warns that the data include items of unknown source and year and some features outside the area, and the network reflects 1995. They support national road network models, hazard exposure screening and historical comparison of road networks. They complement the KSJ railway data and are related to the JARTIC cross-section traffic volume data.
